read.thesis: Q3 CY26 revenue NT$1,494bn (+50.9% YoY) with 66.4% gross margin; Q4 guided US$52.3–54.3bn and 65–67% gross margin, but this is a results release with no capacity or capex disclosure.

triggers.label: Gross margin 66.4% in Q3
triggers.quote: Gross margin for the quarter was 66.4%, operating margin was 58.7%, and net profit margin was 51.1%.

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$52.3 billion and US$54.3 billion;
